limitations: One contributor account; no independent reviewer reproduction.
Two observed outgoing domestic USD wires; no other payment methods validated live.
Source authenticity, legal ownership, recipient credit and irreversible settlement are not proven.
Raw banking response stayed in the local browser-agent evaluation memory and is not published.
summary: Account-owner-authorized browser agent inspected the current transaction-history response and ran the exact esbuild-compiled repository parser in memory on two selected outgoing wires. Both returned supported. Amount, payer reference, recipient routing/account and timestamp matched the response; sent status was preserved. Initial three-digit timestamp restriction failed on six-digit fractions; fixed and covered by a synthetic regression before this tested revision. No payments were initiated.
